scope: Tracked working-tree text and names, manifest-owned packaged files plus package.json, targeted global command/skill and executable-only process snapshot. No personal browser data read.
limitations: Binary strings are not scanned. Logo findings use the separate saved hash audit.
Text matches are not proof of executed branches, network requests, or commercial service dependencies.
Untracked title-reader changes are not in the 0.22.0 package; original SDK build artifacts are counted separately in packaged scope.
The audit does not remove, rename, stop or launch either browser. Audit output files are excluded to prevent self-counting.
